# Joanne Vandermerwe-Mahon

Joanne Vandermerwe-Mahon has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/23/seventh-deputy-candidate-added-to-st-clement-ballot-paper/)\]
